div.div:
رَافِضٌ in the following saying of 'Amr Ibn-Ahmar El-Báhilee means A thrower: he says, “إِذَا مَا الحِجَازِيَّاتُ أَعْلَقْنَ طَنَّبَتْ
بِمَيْثَآءَ لَا يَأْلُوكَ رَافِضُهَا صَخْرَا
” meaning, When the women of El-Hijáz hang their goods and utensils upon the trees, they stretch their tent-ropes and pitch their tent in a soft tract of land, the thrower wherein will not be able to throw a large piece of stone at thee, because of the not finding it. (O, L, K, * TA.) ＝
-A2- See also رَفْضَى.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
